pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

4. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

10. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
